en: The image shows an old villa set against a backdrop of forested hills. The villa is a large, ornate building with multiple chimneys, detailed window frames, and a sloped roof. There is a winding path leading to the entrance, and lush vegetation surrounds the structure. The image is sepia-toned, giving it a vintage appearance. At the bottom, the text reads: 'PIATRA NEAMT' on the left and 'Vila Elise G. Lalu' on the right.
